title: Power Amplifier
summary: The Power Amplifier is an item employed by the Huntik Foundation, seeing usage during the re-appearance of the Blood Spiral. As its name suggests, it amplifies the power of normal Seeker spells - due to its bulk however, it is only employed on certain aircraft, notably the Huntik Foundation's Scramjets, making up for their lack of heavy weaponry.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
The Power Amplifer was used by the Huntik team on their mission [[Defend The Cloisters]]. In order to defeat [[Kiel]] and his men, the Power Amplifier was activated by [[LeBlanche]] to magnify the effects of [[Sophie Casterwill]]'s magic, destroying the room at [[the Cloisters]] and defeating the enemy forces. {{source|The Casterwill Connection}}

During the final battle at the [[Blood Spiral Base]], [[Teien Casterwill]] ordered all [[Huntik Foundation]] and [[Casterwill family]] teams to ready the Power Amplifiers to which they were used to attack the [[Blood Spiral]] soldiers. {{source|Lok and the Betrayer}}

In order to defeat Kiel and his men, the Power Amplifier was activated by LeBlanche to magnify the effects of Sophie Casterwill's magic, destroying the room at the Cloisters and defeating the enemy forces. [The Casterwill Connection]

During the final battle at the Blood Spiral Base, Teien Casterwill ordered all Huntik Foundation and Casterwill family teams to ready the Power Amplifiers to which they were used to attack the Blood Spiral soldiers. [Lok and the Betrayer]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
The Power Amplifier is a powerful item, able to affect all designated Seeker spells in a given area, or focus upon a single room and/or individual. Once affected, a Seeker's chosen spell is given a general boost in power, as well as range - this is seen when [[LeBlanche]] fired a [[Kindlestrike]] from a Huntik Jet, knocking down a Silent Soldier instantly.

When focused upon a single individual, at full power they have the potential to become person's of mass destruction, essentially. [[Sophie Casterwill]] used this to cast an unidentified magic, which affected the whole room and simultaneously blasted the combined forces of the Blood Spirals, Titans and all, for a relatively low investment of energy. {{source|The Casterwill Connection}}
